verdict.rationale: The only first-party AI capability in the pack is "AI-powered creation of meeting minutes," an in-product AI feature that produces output from the user's own business information. That is AI generation rather than true insights or suggestions. The custom license summary and proactive compliance notifications are not described as AI-driven. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or recommendations derived from account data, any documented AI analysis or suggestion feature beyond drafting minutes, detail on how the meeting-minutes AI works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
